children.name: Who are AI 360° workshops designed for? Mobile FAQ Answer
children.content: Students, educators, working professionals, researchers and organisational teams. The pace, examples and tool mix are adapted to each audience.

children.name: Do I need prior AI or technical experience? Mobile FAQ Answer

children.name: Are the workshops live or pre-recorded? Mobile FAQ Answer

children.content: The exact mix depends on your level and goals. Programs may include ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, NotebookLM, n8n, Google AI Studio and specialist research tools.
